turns.text: Hey Lloyd, can you check the version of Warp I have installed? I think it was 1.14.9.
Checking now. Warp is currently on version 1.14.9.
Got it. Also, did my order for the mechanical keyboard switches arrive yet?
The tracking number shows it's out for delivery today.
Nice. I'm planning to make pasta tonight, do you have a quick recipe for aglio e olio?
Sure! Sauté garlic in olive oil, add chili flakes, toss with cooked spaghetti and parsley.
Thanks. Is it going to rain tomorrow?
Yes, 80% chance of showers in the afternoon.
Lloyd, I need to update my internal documentation. Warp remained unchanged at version 1.15.0.dev20260626 during the Newton update.
Understood. I've noted that Warp is on 1.15.0.dev20260626 post-Newton update.
Cool. Also, I finally got those switches in. The tactile feel is great.
Glad to hear it! Enjoy the new typing experience.
I'm trying to fix a bug in my Python script where the loop isn't terminating. Any ideas?
Check if your incrementing variable is actually updating inside the loop, or if you have a floating-point comparison issue.
Ah, it was a float comparison. Fixed. Thanks. Did you see the weather warning for next week?
Yes, a heatwave is expected starting Monday.
